scenario: LINT.6.1 — `i.start` and `i.end` desugar to the interval's start / end expressions respectively. Pin: `(m.window_start..m.window_end).start == m.window_start` over Time slots compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowering, so the desugaring is not observed. `.end` is not used.
rules_ds:
schema W scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    window_start: Time mutable
    window_end: Time mutable

rule r:
    W m where (m.window_start..m.window_end).start == m.window_start
->
    log info "x"
